title: chenopodium album var. incanum
intro: Chenopodium album var. incanum, commonly known as white goosefoot, is a variety of the Chenopodium album plant, a type of annual herb belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of white goosefoot include its ability to stimulate the appetite, relieve nausea, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in treating urinary tract issues and edema. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
